bull.b: Sustained high gross margins (~89–91%) and multi-year revenue growth (TTM ~$240M) indicate strong product-level economics and pricing power for IMCIVREE. These durable unit economics support reinvestment in commercialization and R&D while enabling scalable margin expansion as volumes grow.

Early adoption metrics—400+ start forms, ~300 activated prescribers and sequential Q2 sales growth—reflect durable commercial demand and prescriber engagement. Combined with growing payer coverage and repeat prescribers, this supports sustained revenue expansion as diagnosis and access improve over coming quarters.

bull.t: Conservative leverage and multi-quarter cash runway

This balance sheet cushion supports strategic optionality across commercialization and pipeline development over the next 2+ years.

Persistent unprofitability raises financing risk and delays self-sustaining cash generation absent margin or volume inflection.

bear.t: High operating costs and SG&A growth
bear.b: Rapidly expanding SG&A and sizeable non‑GAAP op‑ex guidance keep cash burn elevated even as sales grow. Continued high commercial and administrative spend pressures operating leverage, lengthens timeline to breakeven, and increases dependence on external funding if revenue scale or margin improvements lag expectations.
